meta.title: NextBosman — Listed contract dates for agents
meta.description: A worldwide search of listed contract dates for football agents. Current availability is not confirmed.
meta.searchDescription: Expired or unknown contracts, and listed future expiry dates, worldwide. Current availability is not confirmed.
meta.searchFreeDescription: Players with a listed past expiry or no contract date in the source. Current availability is not confirmed.
meta.searchExpiringDescription: Players with a future contract date listed in the source. That is not a live confirmation of the current deal.
meta.supportDescription: The desk stays free for agents. Optional donation if it helps you close a call. Pro comes later.

footer.live: Players are loaded from the live database.

support.title: Free to use. Built for agents.
support.lead: Search and matching stay open. If the desk helps you close a call, you can throw something back. A paid Pro comes later — only when it is actually worth €15–20 a month.
support.freeText: Listed contract dates, club briefs and player stats. Current availability is not confirmed. No ads, no account required.
support.donateText: Optional. One coffee, or more if a deal started here. No extra features attached.
support.donateSoon: The donate button appears as soon as a PayPal or Ko-fi link is set.
support.proPrice: Around €15–20 / month, when it is ready
support.proText: Not for sale yet. We will only charge when there is a clear extra: more sources, fresher data, saved briefs. Until then everyone uses the same desk.

home.slogan: The next Bosman is already out there.
home.lead: Your edge is timing. A listed contract date, a club brief, a sporting director who needs a name tonight — that is the window.
home.purpose: NextBosman is a worldwide desk for listed contract dates. Paste a club brief and match names to the request. Current availability is not confirmed.
home.ctaFreeHint: Listed past expiry or missing contract data. Current availability is not confirmed.
home.ctaExpiringHint: A future date is listed in the source. Not a live confirmation.
home.ctaMatchHint: Paste what the club asked for.

points.title: Listed dates first
points.text: Start with expired or unknown contracts, then listed future expiry. Dates come from the source, not a live status check.

points.title: Would they come?
points.text: Matching asks if a player would actually take that league and club — not only if the position fits.

points.title: Stats on click
points.text: Open a player for matches, goals, assists and minutes — enough to decide if the call is worth making.

search.title: The desk

status.allNote: This is not a complete register of every player. It only includes names already in NextBosman, with listed contract dates. Current availability is not confirmed.
status.freeNote: These players have a listed contract end in the past, or no contract date in the source. Current availability is not confirmed. A missing club is not proof that the player is free.
status.expiringNote: The source lists a future contract date. That is not a live confirmation of the current deal.

paste.title: Quick WhatsApp paste
paste.hint: Paste the club message. We match names to the brief, keep the right positions, and mark ideal matches.
paste.placeholder: Paste a WhatsApp enquiry here (e.g. FCSB looking for a ST, free agent, EU passport)...

paste.empty: Request not recognized. Current filters were kept.
paste.salary: Salary mentioned — not in the catalog
paste.transfer: Transfer budget mentioned — not in the catalog
paste.freeUnconfirmed: Free agent requested — current status is not confirmed
